identityClarification: Exactly FOUR compact equipment groups matching reference 1. UPPER LEFT: ONE closed tall dark slate-blue ledger with a brown vertical binding strip and a brown horizontal clasp strap, a brass clasp stud, plus one small plain brass round stud near its lower-right corner. UPPER RIGHT: EXACTLY THREE iron keys hanging on ONE common large closed ring; three separate stems with chunky single notched bits. LOWER LEFT: ONE coiled yellow-brass measuring tape, one loose short end to the left ending in a small dark rectangular tab; use only sparse large engraved tick marks, no numbers or invented text. LOWER RIGHT: ONE small tied brown drawstring pouch with ONE circular brass medallion. Preserve the medallion's source geometry: thin dark central upright stem, two short diagonal outward side branches near its middle and a short forked two-branch base. This little geometric mark is not a readable letter or a new crest; match the visible reference, no starburst or replacement symbol. Keep all four groups separate and complete. No coins spilling, no extra key, scroll, scales, person or hand.
